structured_output.what_is_happening: ARrg9...AChe (GROK / "Grokification") is a 35-minute-old copy of an existing token. It was launched with j7tracker.io, which deploys tokens from a linked tweet. The idea it copies is "Grokification", a meme about turning your profile picture into a Grok-style one ("Grokify your PFP"). The original token for that meme is 6HU4CmRb15C2nQDx8Ld2f2W2wTdmog6aZiiXdrT5Pzi8. That token's website, grokification.com, lists its contract address. It is about 2 days old, has a market cap of about $2.7M, and rose about 185% in the last 24 hours. This copy has done about $6.3M of volume against $137k of liquidity, a turnover of 44x in one hour. The trading pattern is badly lopsided. GeckoTerminal shows 1,081 unique buyers but only 28 unique sellers, and those 28 wallets made 4,388 sell transactions. Unique buyers dropped from 424 in the last 30 minutes to 10 in the last 5 minutes, yet trades are still running at about 760 buys and 769 sells every 5 minutes. That points to automated or wash volume, or a small group of wallets selling into late buyers, not a growing crowd of real traders. The tweet the token links to is a post by @lebombjam, a trading account that is not the project. That account has gone through 6 username changes and has launched 13 tokens. GMGN also found the token's image used on 173 other tokens.

narrative.description: The meme is 'Grokification' / 'Grokify your PFP': people use Grok to turn their profile photo into a cute, round-eyed character with no mouth. The original project claims over 12,345 users and some use by X employees. It sits alongside the wider Grok chibi-avatar trend on X, which Nicki Minaj joined and Elon Musk praised. News about Grok's models (4.7, 4.8, 5) keeps the Grok name in the headlines.
narrative.why_spreading: Grok is always a strong meme theme, and a profile-picture trend spreads easily through X timelines. The original token's 185% gain in 24 hours is drawing copycat launches. This token is one of those copies, not a source of the attention.

token_connection.why_this_token: None beyond the name and ticker being copied. The website that fits the meme (grokification.com) names 6HU4...Pzi8 as the contract. This token's description only says it was deployed with j7tracker, it lists no website of its own (GMGN shows only a usepaid.app page), and its linked X post belongs to a trading account (@lebombjam) that is not the project.
token_connection.competing_tokens: The canonical Grokification GROK is 6HU4CmRb15C2nQDx8Ld2f2W2wTdmog6aZiiXdrT5Pzi8 (market cap ~$2.7M, liquidity ~$178k, website grokification.com). There is another dead Grokification copy (4mkQ...) and an older token simply called GROK (GKeU..., ~$3.1M). Web search also turns up GROKIFY tickers on pump.fun addresses.

authenticity.evidence: 28 unique sellers made 4,388 sells against 1,081 unique buyers. Unique buyers fell from 424 in the last 30 minutes to 10 in the last 5, while the transaction rate stayed about the same. 1-hour turnover is 44x liquidity. GMGN flags 10 bundler wallets and 5 snipers. The token was launched from a tweet, the image appears on 173 other tokens, and the linked X account has been renamed 6 times and has launched 13 tokens. No smart-money or KOL wallets, no organic posts found, and no DexScreener profile.
authenticity.uncertainty: I couldn't read X directly (the fetch returned a 402 error), so I can't see what the lebombjam post says or how many people engaged with it. Some real buyers clearly did come in at first (424 unique buyers in the 30-minute window).

structural_risks: GeckoTerminal puts the top-10 holders at 98.9% (this may include pools). GMGN puts it at 9.5%. The two sources conflict.
RugCheck flags a large share of LP as unlocked and only a few liquidity providers, although GMGN reports the LP burn ratio as 1.0.
Only 28 unique sellers are behind the sell flow, which suggests insiders or bots selling to buyers.
The creator still holds 3.6% of supply.
The original token, with more liquidity, is pulling attention away from this copy.
New buyers dropped almost to zero within 30 minutes.

structured_output.counterargument: The Grokification meme is real and live: the original token is up about 185% in 24 hours and Grok stays in the news. Late copies in PvP trading can sometimes flip the original when the original stalls. This copy has already drawn over 1,000 unique buyers and is trading near its all-time high with $137k of liquidity. If an influencer or the linked tweet's account pushes it, attention could return. The low seller count could also partly reflect holders who simply haven't sold yet, not manipulation.
unknowns: What the @lebombjam post says and how much engagement it got (X returned a 402 error)
Whether private Telegram call groups are pushing this copy
The true holder concentration (GeckoTerminal and GMGN disagree)
Whether an X account tied to the original project mentions this contract

source_coverage.notes: Searching the contract address directly returned nothing. The linked X post was blocked (402 error). grokification.com names the original contract (6HU4), not this one. News searches found Grok model releases and the chibi-avatar trend, but no coverage of this token. The Reddit and Telegram query only turned up the unrelated 2023 GROK token.

structured_output.thesis: This is a copycat token of Grokification, launched from a tweet onto a real but already-claimed meme. Its volume looks driven by bots or a small group of sellers (28 unique sellers against 1,081 buyers), and new buyers dried up within 30 minutes. Attention should fade, not grow.
